newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med mulling sale of Valtur stake.
newsitem.headline: Club Med mulling sale of Valtur stake.

text.p: French resort company Club Mediterranee said on Monday that it was considering selling its 23 percent stake in Italian firm Valtur.
"We're trying to sort out a problem regarding the (three) shareholders of Valtur. A stake sale is one of the options we're considering," a spokesman told Reuters.
He said bank San Paolo de Turin, which owns 53 percent of Valture, "wants a bigger input in management. We're in the process of negotiating."
The other minority shareholder in Valtur is Insud.
Valtur contributed 8.5 million francs last year to Club Med's profit of 169 million francs.
Club Med shares closed up 3.04 percent at 356 francs on a report in an Italian publication about the possible stake sale.
